operating_notes.text: Preferential issue proceeds of ₹132.50 Cr fully utilized as of March 31, 2026.
QIP of ₹174.99 Cr (20,34,883 equity shares) fully utilised by March 31, 2026; issue expenses ₹6.03 Cr, net proceeds ₹168.96 Cr.
Tiruvallur, Tamil Nadu recycling and processing unit capex of ₹49.75 Cr completed as on March 31, 2026.
Board approved setting up a 36,000 MTPA copper recycling plant at Thervoykandigai, Tamil Nadu for ₹200 Cr, funded via internal accruals.
Board approved stock split from face value of ₹5 to ₹2 and appointed Ashish Bansal as Chairman and Managing Director.
Lead capacity increased to 204,000 MTPA in FY26 at Thervoykandigai plant.
Lead production and sales increased by 11% each in FY26 to 104,481 MT and 100,727 MT respectively.
FY27 capex is guided at INR 180 crores to INR 200 crores, funded through internal accruals.

timeline.summary: Pondy Oxides & Chemicals filed the Monitoring Agency Report showing full utilization of ₹132.50 Cr preferential issue proceeds by March 31, 2026.
Pondy Oxides' monitoring agency report showed the ₹174.99 Cr QIP fully utilised by March 31, 2026, with the Tiruvallur recycling unit capex completed.
Pondy Oxides & Chemicals submitted audited financial results for FY26 with an unmodified audit opinion.

Board of Directors, led by **K. Kumaravel (Director Finance & Company Secretary)**, recommended a **final dividend of ₹5 per equity share (100%)** for FY2025-26, pending shareholder approval at the AGM.
Pondy Oxides & Chemicals approved a ₹200 Cr capex on 26 May 2026 to set up a 36,000 MTPA copper recycling plant in Thervoykandigai, Tamil Nadu by December 2026.
On 26 May 2026, Pondy Oxides & Chemicals approved a 2:5 stock split, appointment of a new independent director, and designated Ashish Bansal as Chairman and Managing Director.
On May 26, 2026, Pondy Oxides & Chemicals reported Q4FY26 standalone revenue of ₹932 Cr (+80% YoY) and announced ongoing copper recycling capacity expansion.
K. Kumaravel, Director (Finance) & Company Secretary, shared audio recordings of the Investor Call on 27th May 2026 at 3:30 PM via www.pocl.com.
On May 27, 2026, Pondy Oxides & Chemicals held its Q4 FY26 earnings call, discussing record annual performance and a ₹200 Cr copper cathode plant expansion.
On 27 May 2026, Pondy Oxides & Chemicals held its Q4 FY26 earnings call, guiding for 15% lead volume growth in FY27 and outlining a ₹200 Cr copper cathode expansion.
